components.name: Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover

components.name: Encapsulation Film (EVA or POE)

components.name: Backsheet

components.name: Junction Box with Bypass Diodes

components.name: Cable Harness and Connectors

Solar Cell.name: Silicon
Solar Cell.reasoning: Primary semiconductor material used for photovoltaic conversion, essential for solar cell function as it directly converts sunlight into electricity, universally used in solar cells.

Solar Cell.name: Silver
Solar Cell.reasoning: Commonly used for front contact metallization to collect electrical current efficiently, industry standard though some alternatives exist.

Solar Cell.name: Aluminum
Solar Cell.reasoning: Used for back contact and frame material in the solar cell, providing structural support and electrical conduction, widely used in the industry.

Solar Cell.name: Phosphorus
Solar Cell.reasoning: Standard n-type dopant for silicon in solar cells to form the PN junction, critical for device performance, though arsenic can be an alternative dopant.

Solar Cell.name: Boron
Solar Cell.reasoning: Common p-type dopant for silicon forming the other side of the PN junction, essential for creating the photovoltaic effect, though gallium may substitute in some cases.

Glass Cover.name: Glass
Glass Cover.reasoning: Primary material providing mechanical strength, protection, and optical transparency essential for the glass cover of solar panels, universally the substrate material.

Glass Cover.name: Borosilicate glass
Glass Cover.reasoning: Frequently used glass type for improved thermal and chemical stability in covers, commonly used though some panels may simply use standard glass.

Glass Cover.name: Silicon dioxide
Glass Cover.reasoning: Present as a coating or part of the glass composition providing durability and surface passivation, important for protecting underlying layers though can be substituted with other oxides.

Junction Box.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Junction Box.reasoning: Common polymer material for encapsulation and insulation within the junction box, providing electrical insulation and chemical resistance with some alternatives available.

Junction Box.name: Copper
Junction Box.reasoning: Critical for electrical connections and current conduction inside the junction box, industry standard material due to high conductivity.

Junction Box.name: Silicon
Junction Box.reasoning: Used in semiconducting diodes or protective devices inside junction boxes; common though alternatives in certain designs exist.

Junction Box.name: Epoxy resins
Junction Box.reasoning: Widely used as encapsulant and adhesive for protecting components in the junction box, essential for mechanical stability and environmental protection.

Chassis Assembly.name: Aluminum
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Widely used for solar panel frames and chassis for its low weight, corrosion resistance and structural strength, the industry standard material.

Chassis Assembly.name: Stainless steel
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Used in some chassis for parts requiring high corrosion resistance and strength; an alternative or complement to aluminum.

Chassis Assembly.name: Silicon
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Sometimes used in seals or gaskets in composite materials, though less common; low confidence since many polymer alternatives exist.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Copper
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Primary conductor material offering excellent electrical conductivity essential for high-conductivity cables, absolutely standard in the industry.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Common polymer for insulation or protective coating on cables, widely used though other polymers such as polyethylene or PVC may also be used.
